why: tripMineProximity's idempotency guard is the reaction window's contract (issue #275, owner-revised): staying in or re-entering the radius must not restart or shorten the countdown. Dropping the proximityDelayLeft check lets every in-radius tick re-stamp the delay, so the mine never detonates on schedule. Killed by the re-entry fixture, which pins ONE mine-triggered event and the original detonation call.
